jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for growing the customer base and closing net-new logos for Infisical’s secrets management platform. We are building the #1 open-source security infrastructure stack, and you will play a defining role in growing it!

You will be working closely with our Head of Sales and the rest of the team on:

  • Understanding and demonstrating our products to prospects.

  • Developing, managing, and closing business within accounts in our enterprise accounts segment.

  • Driving the sales cycle from prospect to close and ensuring adoption and consumption of our products.

  • Collaborating with the engineering team to define customer requirements and communicate timelines.

  • Identifying current customers with upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

  • Using innovative sales tools to map, prospect, follow and close your accounts.

Overall, you’re going to be one of the defining pieces of our team as we scale to thousands of customers over the next 18 months.

Requirements

  • Experience selling software to a technical audience (bonus: knowledge and experience with open source, security, and/or infrastructure sales).

  • Demonstrated experience in scaling sales operations from the ground up, including setting up sales processes, CRM systems, and building a sales team.

  • Credibility, and ability to craft compelling cases for change.

  • Experience in navigating multi-stakeholder sales (e.g., IC engineer, director, executive leadership).

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

 

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

jobs.title: Design Engineer, Site
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We’re looking for an exceptional Design Engineer (Site) to own https://infisical.com and show the world what we're about.

In this role, you'll work with engineering, design, and marketing to be the go-to person for everything having to do with building and maintaining the design and infrastructure of the landing page; we want this surface to be iconic and performant to drive organic traffic and user adoption.

This role is for someone who has a frontend-leaning full stack engineering background, who obsesses over crafting pixel-perfect experiences, cares about building sound underlying infrastructure, and is motivated to help build out our growth engine.

You'll work closely with our co-founder, engineering, design, and marketing to:

  • Design and ship pixel-perfect, reusable components and complex designs.

  • Build and maintain core website pages (home, product, blogs, learning/resource hub etc.), microsites, frontend architecture, code quality, CMS integration and experience.

  • Implement SEO best practices, run A/B tests, and optimize conversion funnels.

  • Integrate analytics, attribution, and marketing tooling - Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, HubSpot, etc.

Requirements

  • Deep mastery of JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and frameworks like React/Next.js.

  • Experience building high-quality frontend systems and components with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

  • Experience with web design and design systems.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and eagerness to learn.

  • Bias toward action: able to make decisions, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

  • Based in the Americas (SF preferred) or able to work EST hours.

Nice to have

  • Technical SEO fundamentals.

  • Experience with CMS platforms (e.g. Contentful, Sanity, etc.).

  • Experience configuring website analytics/marketing platform integrations such as with Google Analytics and HubSpot.

  • Experience with developer-facing products or startups.

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

 

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

What We’re Looking For

 

We’re looking for an exceptional Solutions Engineer to help grow Infisical’s customer base and ensure a seamless product experience from onboarding to long-term success.

This is a high-impact, customer-facing role where you’ll work closely with our CEO, sales, and engineering teams. You'll play a critical role in helping organizations adopt Infisical by demonstrating technical value, driving successful implementations, and expanding product usage across accounts.

 

You’ll be working directly with the CEO, engineering, and sales teams on:

  • Running proof-of-concept with leads, guiding customer through onboarding, or being able to recommend best practices for specific architectures and use cases.

  • Ensuring new customers are activated, happy, and have all of their questions answered;

  • Becoming a trusted technical advisor to customer and business leaders.

  • Working in tandem with account executives to lead demo & discovery calls.

  • Talking to customers daily to find points of friction and potential improvement in any workflows, understanding customer's needs and provide feedback towards product roadmap.

  • Understanding user journey and being able to guide UX/DX roadmap

  • Hosting webinars and knowledge sharing sessions for customer's stakeholders.

  • Improving documentation and public facing materials based on customer feedback.

Overall, you’re going to be one of the defining pieces of our team as we scale to thousands of customers over the next 18 months.

 

Requirements

  • Prior experience in development, systems engineering, or DevOps (open source contributions are a plus).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to clearly articulate technical concepts.

  • High energy, high ownership mindset, and a willingness to operate in ambiguity.

  • Based in the United States.

 

Bonus

  • Familiarity with secret management tools or developer security platforms.

  • Solid understanding of developer workflows and/or DevSecOps infrastructure.

  • Prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling environment.

  • Past involvement in developer communities or public speaking (webinars, talks, etc.).

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, DevRel).

  • Experience supporting enterprise accounts and working with technical stakeholders.

 

How You’ll Grow

In this role, you’ll be instrumental in shaping how Infisical scales and serves thousands of customers:

  • Drive technical success across a fast-growing customer base.

  • Influence the short and long-term product roadmap based on customer needs.

  • Help build out the future customer success and go-to-market teams & functions.

 

Team, Values & Benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Figma, AWS, and Red Hat. We operate primarily as a remote team but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Full Stack Engineer to help us build, optimize, and expand the foundation of the platform.

 

We’ve kept our hiring standards exceptionally high since we expect engineers to tackle a broad range of challenges on a day-to-day basis. Examples of past engineering initiatives include developing strategies for secret rotation and dynamic secrets, a gateway to provide secure access to private resources, protocols like EST and KMIP, integrations for syncing secrets across cloud providers, and entire new product lines such as Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM.

 

You’ll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to:

  • Develop and maintain features whilst communicating directly with enterprise customers.

  • Expand our newer Infisical PKI, Infisical PAM, and Infisical KMS product lines.

  • Experiment with novel approaches for applying AI to secrets management and more broadly security infrastructure.

 

Requirements

  • Deep technical mastery of the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript (3+).

  • Exceptional attention to detail and eager to learn.

  • A bias toward action—able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

  • Based in the Americas (US or Canada), Brazil, India, UK, or EU. Must work US hours.

 

Nice to have

  • Expertise in Go.

  • Has some understanding of devops/developer tools.

  • Previous founder or startup experience.

  • Previous experience building in open source or developer tools in either a professional or personal setting.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills to interact with customers directly.

 

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

 

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We’re looking for an exceptional Full Stack Engineer to help us build, optimize, and expand the foundation of the platform.

 

We’ve kept our hiring standards exceptionally high since we expect engineers to tackle a broad range of challenges on a day-to-day basis. Examples of past engineering initiatives include developing strategies for secret rotation and dynamic secrets, a gateway to provide secure access to private resources, protocols like EST and KMIP, integrations for syncing secrets across cloud providers, and entire new product lines such as Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM.

 

You’ll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to:

  • Develop and maintain features whilst communicating directly with enterprise customers.

  • Expand our newer Infisical PKI, Infisical PAM, and Infisical KMS product lines.

  • Experiment with novel approaches for applying AI to secrets management and more broadly security infrastructure.

 

Requirements

  • Deep technical mastery of the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and eager to learn.

  • A bias toward action—able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

  • Based in the Americas (US or Canada), Brazil, India, UK, or EU. Must work US hours.

 

Nice to have

  • Expertise in Go.

  • Has some understanding of devops/developer tools.

  • Previous founder or startup experience.

  • Previous experience building in open source or developer tools in either a professional or personal setting.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills to interact with customers directly.

 

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

 

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We're hiring a Field Marketing Manager to own Infisical's events, both in person and online. You'll run our conference program end to end and build our webinars and partner events into a steady source of pipeline. You'll also work closely with sales before and after each event, so the people we meet turn into meetings and opportunities.

You'll report to our Marketing lead and join an agile team where your work has immediate impact and ideas are tried. While field and event marketing will be your core focus, our fast-paced environment means you'll regularly collaborate across functions, which can mean stepping in to support strategic campaigns, experiment with innovative tools, and drive growth initiatives beyond the scope of traditional event management.

What you'll do

Own our conference program

  • Decide which conferences we go to and how big we go at each one, from a small table to a custom booth

  • Own the events budget and decide where the money goes

  • Manage booth vendors, shipping, swag, staffing, and on-site logistics for events like KubeCon, RSAC, AWS re:Invent, and more

  • Plan side events around conferences, such as happy hours, dinners, and meetups

  • Cultivate strategic relationships with key event organizers to secure prime booth locations and high-visibility speaking opportunities

Run field events with sales

  • Plan and run executive dinners, roundtables, and regional events with our account executives

  • Work with sales before each event to agree on target accounts and book meetings on site

  • Run pre-event outreach so the right people know where to find us

  • Build post-event follow-up with sales and growth marketing, including sales sequences and email nurture, so the people we meet hear from us quickly and more than once

Grow our digital events and partnerships

  • Run our webinar program, from topic and speakers through promotion and follow-up

  • Source and run co-marketing webinars with partners and other developer tools in our space

  • Support our community meetups alongside our startup and ecosystem team

Work across the team

  • Work with our growth marketer on digital promotion for events

  • Work with our content marketing manager on event materials and booth content

  • Look into new tools that could make events and follow-up run better, and help us set them up

What we're looking for

  • 3-4+ years in field marketing, events, or marketing programs at a B2B SaaS company

  • Events you've run that created pipeline, and numbers you can share from them

  • Experience managing booth vendors, event budgets, and logistics across several events at once

  • You like working closely with sales and keeping both teams on the same plan

  • You keep track of vendor deadlines, shipping dates, and registration cutoffs without anyone reminding you

  • You're scrappy. If we ask you to look into a new tool or help on a campaign outside events, you'll jump into it

  • Clear, friendly communication with sales, partners, and vendors

  • Based in the US and able to travel regularly for key events

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing to developers, DevOps, platform engineering, or security teams

  • Existing relationships with organizers of developer and security conferences

  • Experience planning custom booths at large conferences

  • Familiarity with open-source communities or developer meetups

  • Hands-on experience with webinar platforms

Team, values & benefits

  • Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

  • At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We’re looking for a Technical Recruiter to help us build the team behind the open source security infrastructure stack. You’ll own technical hiring end to end, focusing on Engineering, Product, Design and more!

You’ll be working closely with our CTO and engineering team leads to:

  • Define role requirements, align on talent bar and present well-calibrated candidate slates.

  • Map talent across developer tools, infrastructure, and security companies, and build pipelines of both active and passive candidates through direct outreach, referrals, and open source communities.

  • Run a fast, rigorous interview process that keeps candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers excited.

  • Structure and negotiate offers, guiding candidates through to close.

  • Track funnel metrics and use them to spot issues early and improve how we hire.

  • Use and build AI tools across sourcing, outreach, and screening to move faster without compromising candidate experience.

  • Shape recruitment marketing and nurture campaigns that tell Infisical’s story to the engineers we want to hire.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience, ideally at high-growth startups.

  • Proven success hiring in niche, competitive technical talent markets, with hires you can point to from your own outreach.

  • Strong technical literacy: comfortable discussing infrastructure, distributed systems, and developer tooling with engineers.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and clear, compelling written and verbal communication.

  • A bias toward action: able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

  • Experience with Ashby.

  • Based in the US or Canada.

Nice to have

  • Experience recruiting for developer tools, infrastructure, or security companies.

  • Experience as an early recruiter, building recruiting processes and systems from the ground up.

  • Hands-on experience coding or building AI tools in your recruiting workflow.

  • Familiarity with open source communities and developer-led hiring channels.

  • Previous founder or startup experience.

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We're looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to support our CEO and leadership team and help keep Infisical running smoothly as we grow.

In this role, you'll be the go-to person for making sure our leaders spend their time on what matters most. You'll own scheduling, inbox management, travel, offsite planning, office management, business operations, and the countless details that keep a fast-moving startup on track.

You'll work closely with our CEO and leadership team to:

  • Own core administrative tasks, including scheduling, inbox triage, and calendar management, coordinating internal and external meetings, preventing conflicts, and helping leadership use their time effectively.

  • Prioritize and triage what matters, draft responses, protect focus time, and ensure nothing urgent falls through the cracks, including evenings and weekends when needed.

  • Coordinate travel and handle ad hoc tasks quickly, proactively, and with minimal oversight.

  • Use AI tools thoughtfully in your daily work to make processes faster and more efficient.

  • Manage our SF office, dedicating roughly 5 hours per week.

  • Assist with special projects, research, and confidential tasks as needed, such as organizing company offsites, selecting customer gifts, and coordinating events and dinners.

Requirements

  • 1-4 years of experience in Business Operations, Operations, Executive Support, Consulting, or a similar role.

  • Highly process-oriented with a natural inclination to improve how work gets done (e.g., through vibe coding).

  • Low ego and high ownership. You're equally comfortable coordinating an important customer dinner and handling a last-minute travel issue.

  • Excellent judgment and discretion when handling confidential information.

  • Excited to work onsite in our San Francisco office five days per week.

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting a founder or executive at an early-stage startup.

  • Experience planning events, offsites, or office operations.

  • Experience at a developer-facing or B2B software company.

 

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.
